subject: Waterway Information - Subsurface Instruments - Strait of Georgia
text:
Waterway Information - Subsurface Instruments - Strait of Georgia
Two subsurface scientific instruments will be mounted on the seabed in the vicinity of 49 01.086N 123 11.736W and 49 01.038N 123 11.760W
Instruments will be 1.0m above the seabed.
